Cómo se calcula el número de vida: How the life path number is calculated
Se suman todos los dígitos de tu fecha d: You add up all the digits of your birth date and reduce them until you get a single number from 1 to 9. For example, for July 14, 1990: 1 + 4 + 0 + 7 + 1 + 9 + 9 + 0 = 31, and 3 + 1 = 4. If an 11, 22 or 33 shows up along the way, it is not reduced: these are the so-called master numbers, associated with a special intensity.
En la numerología del nombre, cada letra: In name numerology, each letter has a value from 1 to 9 (A=1, B=2, C=3… and it starts over at J). Adding up the letters of your full name gives you the expression number, which describes your natural way of showing up in the world.
